title: Agent launch through the cratylus extension
situation: omp discovers extensions before it applies command-line flags, and lets an extension register its own flags.
decision: Agent launch is realized by the same always-loaded cratylus omp extension: it registers the flag that selects the agent and, for the session, applies that agent's definition whole. No launcher exists outside the harness.
consequences: Retires the architect and cratylus launchers placed in the operator's local bin as stopgaps, and the architect text's clause about being dispatched.
